import threading
import psycopg,pytest
from agent_guard.contracts.execution import ExecutionError
from agent_guard.execution import store as es
from tests.fixtures.execution import expire_lease
from tests.fixtures.dbstate import fetch_counts
from test_review import accepted,observe,counters,effects

@pytest.mark.parametrize('round_no',range(10))
def test_old_expired_and_new_terminal_race(a2,round_no):
 op=accepted(a2).operation_id;saved={}
 def capture(c,o):saved.update(claim=c,outcome=o);raise RuntimeError('owned sync')
 with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):a2.service.run_operation(op,owner_token='old',pause=capture)
 expire_lease(a2.gateway_dsn,op)
 newer=a2.service._claim(op,'new')
 assert newer.previous_status=='EXECUTING' and newer.lease.fencing_version==2
 outcome=a2.downstream.query(service_secret=a2.secret,operation_id=op)
 barrier=threading.Barrier(2);results=[]
 def finalize(c):
  barrier.wait()
  try:results.append(('ok',a2.service._finalize(c,outcome,downstream_called=True,reason='').status))
  except ExecutionError as e:results.append(('error',e.code.value))
 ts=[threading.Thread(target=finalize,args=(c,)) for c in [saved['claim'],newer]]
 for t in ts:t.start()
 for t in ts:t.join(10)
 assert not any(t.is_alive() for t in ts) and len(results)==2 and [r for r in results if r[0]=='ok']==[('ok','SUCCEEDED')]
 assert all(v=={'amount_reserved':0,'amount_settled':70000,'calls_reserved':0,'calls_settled':1} for v in counters(a2))
 assert effects(a2)['ds_orders']==1 and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_receipt_outbox']==1 and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_ledger_events']==2
 observe('expired-old-new-race',{'round':round_no,'results':results,'counters':counters(a2)})

@pytest.mark.parametrize('round_no',range(10))
def test_root_initialization_concurrency_repeat(dsn,migrated,namespace,round_no):
 from tests.integration.test_state_checks import test_p11_concurrent_root_initialization_creates_one_root
 test_p11_concurrent_root_initialization_creates_one_root(dsn,migrated,namespace)
 observe('root-init-repeat',{'round':round_no,'counts':fetch_counts(dsn)})
